name: Larry Bushey
title: Project Contributor
bio_raw:
I have been the creator, producer, and host of the [Going Linux Podcast](https://goinglinux.com) since 2007. The ~400 episodes of the podcast and the supporting website help Linux computer users with practical advice on how to get the most from their corporate and personal technologies and software applications.

As a member of the [Ubuntu MATE team](https://ubuntu-mate.org/about/team): 
* Regular contributor in the [Ubuntu MATE community](https://ubuntu-mate.community/u/goinglinux).
* Since 2017 I have authored the official Ubuntu MATE guide, provided with every installation of the Ubuntu MATE distribution, to help new users navigate their Linux system. 
* The HTML version of the onboard help content provided in the [Ubuntu MATE Guide](https://guide.ubuntu-mate.org) is available on the Ubuntu MATE website. 
* I created the highlights video for Ubuntu MATE 20.04 featured on the website's [About](https://ubuntu-mate.org/about) page. 
* I have authored [two books about Ubuntu MATE](https://ubuntu-mate.org/shop/books) for computer users who just want the information they need to learn how to use Ubuntu MATE and its applications. They are featured on the Ubuntu MATE website. Reading these books can help you build your confidence and competence in using Ubuntu MATE.

name: Stephen Yates
bio_raw:
I am relatively new to Linux. I am just south of 60 and have been a Windows user since 3.1. I actually started a couple years ago with Ubuntu Touch and had fun loading UT on older Nexus 5 phones. Then I dragged out some old laptops and started loading different distros. I started with Ubuntu and then tried MINT, MX, Debian and Fedora but I kept coming back to Ubuntu. I discovered MATE and have never looked back.

I am a graphic designer so my main desktop is still Windows, but my daily driver is my 10th gen Dell laptop and I spend more time on it then I do the desktop.

name: Mr. Beedell, Roke Julian Lockhart (RJLB)
bio_raw:
As [my GitLab profile's `readMe.MD`][1] states:
I am a system administrator and FOSS QA engineer, specialising in operating systems. I am distinctly interested in graphical interface consistency and accessibility. Although I am under NDA for some of my work, I have worked with Microsoft Partner Centre and MSVC, Google's AOSP development team, KDE e.V, possess edit access on the Chromium Issue Tracker, and have submitted patches to Firefox. As of 2025-08, I had opened 1 990 issues on the official GitHub instance, with an 80 % non-rejection rate. Similarly, I had opened 394 at KDE's Bugzilla instance, 160 at Mozilla's, 324 at Red Hat's, and 2 at the Linux kernel's. During my work, I have become an ardent EU and UN federalist, and support Europol, NATO, the ICC, and ICJ. I have also acquired many roles: - Multi-Scheme Administrator, for Neighbourhood Watch Network - Angel, for Fairphone B.v - Co-Opted Digital Communications Lead, for Norfolk Neighbourhood Watch Association - Co-Opted Member, Hanworth with Gunton Memorial Hall Management Committee - Co-Opted Member, Hanworth Commons Management Committee #### Badges [![My Last Played Song, From `Last.FM`](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?color=blueviolet&url=https://lastfm-last-played.biancarosa.com.br/BEEDELLROKEJULI/latest-song?format=shields.io)](https://github.com/biancarosa/lastfm-last-played)
[1]: https://dub.sh/KWTsOXP

Hello,

I am Ahmed Bakr, also known as MesterPerfect. I am passionate about programming, technology, and anything related to it. I also enjoy helping others by sharing the knowledge I have gained through research and exchanging experiences with those who share similar interests.

I strive to learn something new every day in my areas of interest, so that I can continually build upon my knowledge and experiences.

Currently, I work as a YouTube content creator and as a server manager and web developer. My goal is to assist people of all ages in learning how to use computers and programming languages, and to help them achieve their goals with ease.

In the videos I publish, I try to make the information as simple and straightforward as possible. If you have any issues while learning, please do not hesitate to reach out to me, as I am always happy to offer assistance.
